questions.question: What does Tovy do exactly?
questions.answer: I connect business systems, automate manual processes and manage cloud environments. Concrete example: the daily manual export of orders from your webshop to your ERP. I turn that into an automatic connection that runs without errors.

questions.question: How is Tovy different from an IT agency?
questions.answer: You work directly with me, the engineer who designs and builds your systems. No account managers, no project managers, no overhead. That keeps costs low and communication short.

questions.question: What type of company is Tovy suited for?
questions.answer: Small companies (10 to 50 employees) in supply chain, retail, logistics or operations. Especially companies with multiple systems — SAP, Shopify, accounting software, warehouse systems — that don't communicate properly with each other.

questions.question: Why not a large consulting firm?
questions.answer: The same technical expertise, without the overhead. Because I develop with AI assistance, build costs are €5,000 to €15,000 instead of €50,000 to €100,000 at an agency. Management costs €800 to €2,000 per month — a fraction of an internal engineer.

questions.question: How does the collaboration work?
questions.answer: On a monthly retainer basis. I work 8 to 16 hours per week on your systems: building new connections, improving existing automations, managing the cloud environment. Ongoing, not one-off.

questions.question: How do I get started?
questions.answer: Fill in the intake form or book a call directly. In the first conversation I map your current situation and we determine if there's a fit.

questions.question: How quickly will I see results?
questions.answer: The first automation or integration is typically live within 2 to 4 weeks. From that moment, the process runs automatically and we keep building.

questions.question: How does knowledge transfer work?
questions.answer: Everything I build is documented. Code, configuration and procedures live in your own environment. If the engagement ends, everything keeps running.

metadata.title: Privacy Policy & GDPR Compliance
metadata.description: Read Tovy's GDPR-compliant privacy policy on data collection and server-side tracking.

content.title: Privacy Policy
content.intro: Tovy respects your privacy. This policy describes how Tovy handles data collected through this website, in compliance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

sections.title: Data controller
sections.content: Tovy is the data controller for personal data collected through this website. For questions, you can contact Tovy via:

sections.title: Data collection and use
sections.content: Tovy only requests personal data when necessary to provide a service. Tovy collects data lawfully, with your knowledge and explicit consent. The legal grounds for processing are consent, contractual necessity and legitimate interest.
list: Intake form: Tovy collects names, contact details (email, phone), company information and project details. This data is stored in Google Cloud Firestore and used to assess requests. The basis is the intention to enter into an agreement.

Server logs: The web server, hosted by Firebase Hosting, automatically records requests such as IP addresses, browser types and visited pages. The basis is the legitimate interest in maintaining a secure website.
Cookies: Tovy uses necessary cookies to manage your consent preferences. Tovy does not use tracking cookies without your explicit prior consent via the cookie banner.

sections.title: Data location and transfer
sections.content: The primary database (Cloud Firestore) is located within the European Union (region 'eur3'). Tovy prefers EU services, but some subcontractors may transfer data internationally. This is done exclusively via legally permitted mechanisms, such as standard contractual clauses.

sections.title: Retention and security
sections.content: Tovy only retains personal data as long as necessary for service delivery or as legally required. Tovy protects data with industry-standard security measures to prevent loss, theft and unauthorised access.

sections.title: Rights under the GDPR
sections.content: Under the GDPR, you have the following rights regarding your personal data:
list: Right to information: Knowing how your data is collected and used
Right of access: Requesting a copy of the stored information
Right to rectification: Having incorrect data corrected
Right to erasure: Requesting to have data deleted
Right to restriction: Having processing temporarily paused
Right to portability: Receiving data in a machine-readable format
Right to object: Objecting to the processing of personal data
sections.footer: To exercise these rights, you can contact us via the email address below.

content.effectiveDate: This policy has been in effect since July 30, 2024.
